sources.title: Planck 2018 results IV. Diffuse component separation
sources.read_scope: Exa search primary fulltext highlights: abstract, §2.4 SMICA, map processing/FFP10 discussion; Exa fetch extracted first 90000 chars, not complete paper.
sources.reuse: Product-specific operator and common-sky component robustness; end-to-end simulation fidelity not automatic exact sampling law.
limits: Do not promote four component maps to four independent sky experiments.
Noise simulation mismatch reported in primary paper.

sources.title: Planck Legacy Archive official 2018 CMB map product documentation
sources.read_scope: Overview, product descriptions SMICA/Common Masks, filenames, CMB simulations selected sections.
sources.reuse: SMICA harmonic weights, beam/output layout; 999 CMB realizations and 300 noise realizations propagated through each pipeline; common science masks; inpainted PR products distinguished.
limits: Monopole/dipole removal statement in SEVEM subsection must not be automatically attributed to SMICA; exact SMICA map header/dipole provenance still required.
999x300 combinations are not automatically 299700 independent skies.

sources.title: Planck 2013 results XXVII. Doppler boosting of the CMB: Eppur si muove
sources.read_scope: Abstract, Introduction, §2 Doppler/aberration observable extraction and relevant fulltext fetched excerpts; selected later calibration discussion. Not independent rerun.
critical_formulas: Doppler modulation of anisotropy and aberration off-diagonal covariance
sources.reuse: Independent small-scale velocity-sensitive channels as endpoint response; quoted primary result v_parallel=384 km/s +/-78 stat +/-115 syst.
limits: Observed Doppler/aberration signatures have model-dependent interpretation; use PS05/PS06 for intrinsic contribution.
Does not establish global matter tilt or Bianchi geometry.

sources.title: New operator approach to the CMB aberration kernels in harmonic space
sources.read_scope: Full PDF extraction returned; directly read §§II–IV Eqs.(2)–(5),(14)–(20),(22), plus selection of introduction/conclusion. Other recursion/appendix sections fetched but not audited in entirety.
critical_formulas: K=<s ell' m'|exp(i eta.Y)|s ell m>
sources.reuse: Exact endpoint thermodynamic-temperature pullback, first-order generator; full-sky E/B result for Doppler weight d=1.
limits: Specific intensity d=3 and integrated intensity d=4 are different fields.
Cut-sky leakage excluded from full-sky nonmixing statement.
Fetched arXiv current rendering date differs from original 2014 publication; version identity recorded, not silently equated.

sources.title: Interpreting the CMB aberration and Doppler measurements: boost or intrinsic dipole?
sources.read_scope: Full PDF extraction returned; direct selected read §3.1 Eqs.(3.9)–(3.12), intrinsic aberration profile discussion, §4 Eqs.(4.15)–(4.20), Table1 and §5 conclusion.
sources.reuse: Construct intrinsic-potential alternative and dipolar-lensing nuisance; not assume aberration/Doppler agreement logically unique to endpoint boost.
limits: Doppler derivation explicitly large-scale and matter-domination; small-scale extension unproved in this source.
Fine-tuned profile degeneracy is model scoped, not strong universal no-go.

sources.title: First constraints on the intrinsic CMB dipole and our velocity with Doppler and aberration
sources.read_scope: PDF full extraction; directly read introduction, Estimators and pipeline, Eq.(1), TableI, intrinsic dipole measurement and selected Results.
sources.reuse: Separate three vector observables; dipole-distortion conversion artifact removal and mask/noise/leakage simulation calibration; 3.7 mK upper limit under standard dipolar lensing.
limits: Free general model has 9 observables/10 unknowns.
Upper bound and inferred solar velocity depend on dipolar lensing/NG model.
External bound not a new reboot observation.

sources.title: How isotropic is the Universe?
sources.read_scope: Main 5-page article extraction read: anisotropic modes, likelihood/calibration/prior/parameter tables, results/conclusions. Supplement not fetched/audited.
critical_formulas: a_obs = stochastic FLRW component + anisotropic deterministic pattern
sources.reuse: Native near-isotropic Bianchi T/E/B pattern + covariance/calibration likelihood example; motivates harmonic atlas and prior-sensitive comparison.
limits: Flat/open homogeneous near-FLRW models and particular matter assumptions, not every Bianchi/multi-fluid state.
Closed IX omitted from tested family scope.
Published evidence/prior not transplantable as independent p or likelihood for new study.

sources.title: Exact testing with random permutations
sources.read_scope: Primary PDF text direct read introduction, Definition1/basic full-group test, §§3.1–3.4 and Theorem2/proof excerpts; article remainder fetched.
critical_formulas: p=(1+sum_i 1{S_i>=S_0})/(N+1) for suitable identity-included random transformations/Monte Carlo experiment
sources.reuse: Distinguish Monte Carlo draws from random transformations; invariance/group/identity and sampling rules required.
limits: Plus-one arithmetic alone does not certify exchangeability.
Composite nuisance/fit rules require separate validity proof or calibration.

sources.title: Planck 2018 results VII. Isotropy and statistics of the CMB
sources.read_scope: Primary search detailed excerpts: intro/a-posteriori choices, FFP10 comparison, component common-mask/null HMHD/OEHD analysis; fetch first 90000 chars returned, not full later anomaly tables.
sources.reuse: Same processing/masks per pseudo-observation; simulation fidelity null tests; look-elsewhere selection calibration.
limits: No figure-derived anomaly p imported.
Public polarization simulation fidelity limitations not generic approval gate; identify actual chosen-test impact.

limitations: Empirical conditional cyclic-noise calibration; independent-sky rank theorem not established.
